{{Quote|I am Major Fenris Sarhl, commander of the CompForce Demnadi Relief Operation, part of the regiment assigned to pacify this ... planet of yours.|Fenris Sahrl|<ref name="heroes" />}}
'''Fenris Sarhl''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who held the rank of [[Major/Legends|major]] in [[CompForce/Legends|CompForce]], the military wing of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he was deployed to [[Demnadi]], following attacks and riots organized by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. When the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] administrator, [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Cathers]], questioned how many squads Sarhl's relief force consisted of, the major answered that he was the only one who was sent.<ref name="heroes" />
